# Weeknight Tacos

## Ingredients

- 1 lb ground beef
- 8 corn tortillas
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1 cup shredded cheddar
- 1 lime
- 0.5 cup salsa

## Steps

1. Brown the beef over medium-high, 6 to 8 minutes; drain.
2. Stir in seasoning with 2/3 cup water; simmer 3 minutes.
3. Warm tortillas; assemble with cheese, salsa, lime.
